title: Speaking — Local shops
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on local shops.

questions: Where do you usually spend time with friends?
How do you keep in touch with friends you rarely see?
What kinds of activities do you normally do together?
Do you prefer meeting one friend or a group?
What kind of shops do you visit most often?
Do you prefer shopping near home?

part2.topic: Describe a small shop you would miss if it closed.
part2.closing: and explain what makes it valuable to the area.

questions: How can independent shops compete with large retailers?
Why do some neighbourhoods lose shops even when their population grows?
How has everyday life connected with local shops changed for people of different ages?
